page.overview:
Who is Hideo?

A nonbender native of Jasmine Island, Hideo experienced the political crisis of his homeland in the 100s AG. and Hideo wholeheartedly backed this stance.

The political crisis on Jasmine Island eventually continued to escalate when it became known that someone had stolen a bag of golden jasmine seeds from the yearly harvest, a symbolically potent and disruptive action. Though he tried to stay calm, he soon started to nervously ask the protectors about the progress of their investigation and the future of the upcoming election, while he tried to deflect any questions about the missing seeds.

Though Hideo outwardly displayed a calm demeanor, this just disguised his constant anxiety and nervousness. His fears were mainly focused on his homeland's future, causing him to seek ways to unite the Jasmine Islanders. Under pressure, Hideo was prone to losing his composure, even when he had nothing to actually worry about.
